notes.title: Zeroptian Invasion - The Final Version
notes.content:
The game has been permanently reduced in price, from $4.99 to $2.99.

In addition, the following improvements and bugfixes have been included:
[list]
[*]You can now set/remove the arcade bezel by pressing "Select" on the joystick or F1 on the keyboard.
[*]Collision fixes.
[*]Hitbox 1st boss bug.
[*]Now you can move with A and D on keyboard.
[*]The player always start with 3 lives now.
[/list]

Thanks for your infinite support,
José

notes.title: v3.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
-Bugs visual.
-Small mistakes in the menu.
-Optimization.

Hi all! Thanks again for all the support shown to the game. If everything goes well this will be the latest update of Zeroptian Invasion. Anyway, expect a couple of surprises soon. A greeting!

notes.title: v2.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed some visual errors.
- Resolutions adjusted.
- Optimization.
- Bug when hitting walls arranged.

notes.title: v2.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
NEWS
---------
- Vibration mode for controllers.
- Vertical rotation TATE.
- Now the windows are scaled in pixel-perfect.
- Characteristic changes in some levels.

BUGS
---------
- The first Boss no longer jams when firing bursts of shots.
- Problem when collecting shields in the exact frame of destruction.

Thanks to everyone who is helping me discover mistakes in the game and leave it more polished. I hope you enjoy the new options. A greeting!

notes.title: v1.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Corrected synchronization error with Hz.
[*] Bug in the fight against the spider fixed.
[*] Resource Optimization.
[/list]

I hope to continue improving the game over the next few days so that it is as polished as possible. A greeting!

notes.title: The invasion begins!
notes.content:
After many years of dreaming about the idea of publishing a game, it finally becomes a reality. Thank you to all who have made it possible and expect news in the future.

Any bug or problem that you have please let me know.
Having said that, I hope you enjoy the game :)

A greeting.
